task_text: A audio company make two types of headphones: wired headphones and wireless headphones. Two different teams make each type of headphones. The wired team can make at most 100 wired headphones per day and the wireless team can make at most 170 wireless headphones per day. Both teams require use of a shared audio testing machine, and this machine can be used to make a maximum of 150 headphones per day. The profit per wired headphone is $50 and the profit per wireless headphone $20. How many of each headphone should be made to maximize profit?
